User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the VoltaConnect platform with specific roles and associated details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity.

email.description: The email address of the user.

role.description: The role of the user within the system (Super Admin, Operator, End User).

associatedStationId.description: Reference to the Station associated with an Operator. (Relationship: Station 1:N User)

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the user account was created.

Station.title: Station
Station.description: Represents an EV charging station managed by the platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Station entity.

name.description: The name of the charging station.

location.description: Geographical location details of the station.

status.description: Current operational status of the station (active/offline).

operatorId.description: Reference to the Operator managing this station. (Relationship: User 1:N Station)

totalPower.description: Total power capacity of the station in kW.

chargerCount.description: Number of individual chargers available at this station.

Charger.title: Charger
Charger.description: Represents an individual EV charger unit within a station.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Charger entity.

stationId.description: Reference to the Station this charger belongs to. (Relationship: Station 1:N Charger)

currentUsage.description: Current power usage of the charger in kW.

status.description: Current operational status of the charger (available, occupied, out_of_service).

ratePerKwh.description: Charging rate per kilowatt-hour for this charger.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Records details of a completed EV charging session.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Transaction entity.

userId.description: Reference to the End User who initiated the transaction. (Relationship: User 1:N Transaction)

stationId.description: Reference to the Station where the transaction occurred. (Relationship: Station 1:N Transaction)

duration.description: Duration of the charging session in minutes.

cost.description: Total cost of the charging session.

energyDelivered.description: Total energy delivered during the session in kWh.

timestamp.description: Date and time when the transaction was recorded.

Booking.title: Booking
Booking.description: Represents a user's reservation for a charging slot at a specific station.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Booking entity.

userId.description: Reference to the End User who made this booking.

stationId.description: Reference to the Station where the booking is made.

operatorId.description: The ID of the operator who manages the station.

stationName.description: Denormalized name of the station for display.

status.description: The current status of the booking.

definition.description: Stores details for each EV charging station.

params.name: stationId
params.description: The unique identifier of the charging station.

params.name: bookingId
params.description: The unique identifier of the booking.
